oracle.ref: PR #1226 (fix); fix evidence: dev cowork.tracy.site 12/10/2026: OpenAI's consent page refused the first try with 'Enable device code sign-in for Codex, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word in ChatGPT Security Settings' (a per-account switch, off by default); the panel said nothing. Screens: tasks/evidence/device-poll-transient/codex-device-hint-{light,dark}.png
oracle.invariant: The Codex device panel holds [data-hint='device-security'] reading 'ChatGPT accepts the code only when Device code sign-in is on in ChatGPT Settings › Security.' Its link reads 'ChatGPT Settings › Security', href https://chatgpt.com/#settings/Security, target _blank, rel 'noopener noreferrer'; on the web a press follows the anchor itself into a new tab (no popup), in the desktop app it opens through openExternal (since #1227). The GitHub Copilot device panel has no [data-hint='device-security'].
